lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: It's the two of you. Separations and Transport walking in beside a therapist—that's what a reassignment looks like from down here.
lines.context: GDD 5.10: Marco names the analyst-plus-therapist configuration residents recognize.

lines.speaker: Peris
lines.context: The Rings scene plants dread but does not give Peris the later recognition yet.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: I know. They don't. People see that shape and get out of the corridor before it chooses them.
lines.context: GDD 5.10: the scatter is caused by the reassignment configuration, not rank.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Peris looks from Marco to Aster, then to Endo watching the corridor. Something has shifted, but she cannot name the whole of it yet.
lines.context: GDD 5.10: this scene holds the seed; recognition belongs to the later Psyknapse scene.
